Grim Anticheat (Bukkit / Folia build)
=====================================

Component: grimac-bukkit-*.jar (installed as plugins/grim.jar)
Upstream:  https://github.com/GrimAnticheat/Grim
Modrinth:   https://modrinth.com/plugin/grimac
License:    GNU General Public License v3.0 (see LICENSE-GPLv3.txt)
Copyright:  GrimAnticheat contributors

YaPcore does not modify this jar. It is an optional third-party anti-cheat for
YaP-Folia backends. Fetch with:

  ./scripts/fetch-grim.sh

Source code corresponding to the binary is available from the upstream GitHub
repository and Modrinth release files. If you redistribute a YaPcore package that
includes this jar, you must also provide recipients with GPLv3 rights to Grim
(include this NOTICE + LICENSE, and a pointer to source).

YaPcore first-party code is GPLv3 — same license family as Grim.
See docs/start/LICENSING.md and third-party/grim/LICENSE-GPLv3.txt.
